title: Gaurang Patel on the AI Conference — the O'Reilly fireside was 'the session that tied it together for me'
summary: Patel attended The AI Conference 2026 at Pier 48 in San Francisco. His post on LinkedIn worked through the 134-session agenda for six themes, among them the multi-model era and governance as an engineering discipline, and picked the Eric Ries and Tim O'Reilly session as the one that connected them.
blockquote: The session that tied it together for me: Eric Ries and Tim O'Reilly on Building AI Companies That Matter. The question isnt just what AI can build — its what kind of companies and institutions we build with it.
